subject: Notice invoking arbitration clause - Supply Agreement NX/SC/26/118
body:
To the Legal Department,

Under instructions from our client, Meridian Cooling Components, we hereby invoke Clause 19 of the Supply and Distribution Agreement dated 14 February 2025 between our client and Nexora. A sum of INR 18,74,650 remains disputed and unpaid despite reconciliation meetings held on 7 August and 19 September 2026. Our client proposes appointment of a sole arbitrator in Mumbai in accordance with the agreement. Kindly communicate Nexora's concurrence or proposed procedure within 30 days of receipt of this notice. All rights and remedies are expressly reserved.

Adv. Shalini Vartak
Vartak Legal Chambers

subject: MSME payment case - pls check
body:
We supplied copper wiring assemblies worth Rs 8,92,400 to your Pune service operation. Bills NXB-771, NXB-789 and NXB-804 have crossed the agreed payment period and our accounts team has sent reminders since June. Udyam number is UDYAM-MH-19-0084172. We have filed an application on the MSME Samadhaan portal and received acknowledgement MH/2026/11482. Please confirm who will handle the response. We cannot keep extending credit indefinitely.

Regards,
Prakash

subject: Notice for injury caused by refrigerator
body: I represent Mrs. Charulata Purohit of Nashik, who purchased a Nexora Frostline 460 refrigerator on 11 May 2026. On 3 October, the rear electrical panel allegedly sparked and caused burns to her left forearm while she was cleaning the kitchen. The incident also damaged a wooden cabinet and nearby wiring, estimated at INR 67,000. She has medical records and photographs of the appliance. Despite a service visit under complaint reference NX-SV-662910, she has not received a written incident assessment. Please preserve the unit and service records and provide a substantive response within 14 days. This communication is made without prejudice to her rights under applicable law.

sender_name: Office of the Public Information Officer
subject: Fwd: RTI application concerning procurement records
body: For your information and necessary action, an RTI application received on 19 October 2026 seeks records relating to the procurement of electronic equipment supplied to a municipal training centre. The application was originally addressed to the Directorate of Technical Education and has been forwarded to your organisation for examination of the portions relating to Nexora. Please identify any commercially confidential information and provide relevant records, if held, by 4 November 2026. The forwarding does not determine whether Nexora is a public authority under the RTI Act.

subject: Urgent: customer data shared without consent
body: I registered my Nexora washing machine online in July. Last week I received promotional calls from three unrelated loan agents who knew my full name, phone number, home area and product model. I never consented to sharing my registration details for this purpose. Your support team closed ticket NX-PR-88412 saying the matter was forwarded internally, but nobody has explained what happened. Please confirm within 7 days whether my information was disclosed, the categories of recipients involved and what steps are being taken. I have retained call logs and screenshots.

subject: Demand to remove defamatory publication
body: Our client, Vistara Home Retail, has brought to our attention a public post published by an account apparently associated with Nexora's regional marketing activity. The post dated 12 October 2026 describes our client as a 'fraud dealer selling duplicate stock' without identifying any verified findings. The statement has been shared widely in local retailer groups and has affected ongoing commercial discussions. Kindly preserve the original post, campaign approval trail and related correspondence. We request removal or correction within 10 days and a written explanation of the verification undertaken before publication. This notice is not a request to suppress genuine consumer feedback.

subject: Software licence compliance review
body: Our software asset monitoring partner has identified several installations of SoftGrid Enterprise Edition on systems associated with your Ahmedabad and Delhi offices. The licence records we can verify cover 24 concurrent users, while the usage report indicates 39 active installations. This may be caused by device replacement or stale inventory records; we are not assuming deliberate infringement at this stage. Please arrange a licence reconciliation and provide a written response within 21 days. We request that relevant installation logs and purchase invoices be retained pending resolution.

subject: Summons for production of records - GST/MUM/26/9081
body: M/s Nexora is requested to produce the purchase registers, e-invoice reconciliation statements, input tax credit workings and related correspondence for the period April 2024 to March 2026 in connection with verification proceedings under the applicable provisions of the CGST Act, 2017. The authorised representative shall attend at the office specified in the attached summons on 9 November 2026 at 11:30 AM. Please bring the originals where required and a copy of the authorisation letter. The summons reference and reporting instructions are contained in the attached document.

subject: Fwd: Income tax notice for response
body:
Please see attached communication received by our client, Nexora, through the income tax portal. The notice refers to a mismatch between reported interest income and the figures appearing in the annual information statement for Assessment Year 2024-25. The response window shown in the portal is 14 days from service. Kindly confirm who is coordinating with Finance and whether the bank interest certificates and original return computation are available. Please do not submit a response until the figures have been reconciled with the tax consultant.

Forwarded for immediate review.

subject: Import consignment held - Bill of Entry 7319462
body: The consignment declared under Bill of Entry 7319462 dated 16 October 2026, containing wireless accessory modules imported for Nexora, has been referred for verification of applicable product compliance documentation. Please submit the relevant BIS registration details, product descriptions, supplier invoices and catalogue specifications within 7 days. Clearance remains subject to completion of the required examination. The importer or authorised customs broker may contact the designated assessment group with the reference quoted in the subject.

sender_name: Office of the Assistant Labour Commissioner
subject: Conciliation proceedings - Case ALC/P/2026/441
body: Nexora is informed that a complaint has been received from a former employee concerning alleged non-payment of gratuity following separation from employment. The matter is listed for conciliation on 18 November 2026 at 12:00 noon at the office stated in the attached notice. The authorised company representative should attend with the appointment letter, separation documents, calculation sheet and proof of any payment made. Kindly acknowledge receipt and confirm the name of the attending representative within 3 working days.

subject: Consumer authority notice - advertised MRP
body: We represent a consumer who purchased a Nexora 1.5-ton inverter air conditioner from a retail outlet in Vadodara on 4 October 2026. The online listing showed a price of INR 38,490, while the invoice charged INR 41,990 before installation. The customer alleges that the advertised price was presented as the payable price and that additional mandatory charges were not disclosed clearly. A complaint has been lodged with the relevant consumer protection authority under reference CCPA/WR/26/1924. Please preserve the product listing, price history, promotion terms and dealer communications and provide your position within 10 days.

subject: Repudiation disputed - warehouse equipment loss
body: I act for Nexora's insured logistics contractor, whose stored television stock was damaged by water ingress at a warehouse in Bhiwandi on 22 August 2026. The insurer has repudiated the claim under policy reference MGI/PROP/663821, citing inadequate safeguards, although the inspection report records a failure in the building's drainage system. The assessed stock loss is INR 12,68,300. Please confirm whether Nexora intends to join the correspondence as the goods owner or beneficiary. We request preservation of stock movement records, invoices and warehouse inspection communications pending further proceedings.

subject: Notice regarding dealer appointment termination
body: Nexora terminated our dealership for the Bhavnagar territory by email dated 20 October, without completing the quarterly stock reconciliation. We have unopened inventory worth approximately INR 9,35,000 and a security deposit of INR 3,00,000 with the company. Your sales representative says the deposit will be adjusted against 'market support costs', but we have not received any statement showing how this figure was calculated. Please provide the contractual basis and account reconciliation within 14 days. We are willing to meet to resolve the matter, but we cannot accept an unexplained deduction.

sender_name: Estate Officer, Pimpri Chinchwad Municipal Corporation
subject: Notice: unauthorised alteration at commercial premises
body: An inspection conducted on 15 October 2026 at the commercial premises occupied by Nexora's service operation in Pimpri has recorded an enclosed extension near the loading area that does not appear in the approved building plan. You are directed to submit the sanctioned plan, occupancy documents and explanation within 7 days of service of this notice. Further action will be considered under the applicable municipal provisions if the discrepancy remains unresolved. The site details and inspection observations are enclosed.

subject: Fwd: E-filing acknowledgement - COM/2026/008741
body: This is an automated intimation that a commercial dispute filing referencing Nexora has been accepted for scrutiny by the competent court registry. Filing number COM/2026/008741 was generated on 21 October 2026. This message is not a determination on the merits of the matter and does not itself confirm that a summons has been served. Please use the filing number to verify the case details through the official e-filing facility. The attached acknowledgement contains the filing party and next procedural status.

subject: Document preservation - litigation hold required
body: In connection with a dispute concerning the distribution agreement with Eastbay Retail Networks, please ensure immediate preservation of all relevant electronic and physical records. This includes emails, messaging-app communications, pricing approvals, sales forecasts, delivery logs and versions of the agreement dated 6 March 2026. Please suspend routine deletion for records relating to account EB-441 and identify custodians who handled the account. Do not alter or destroy potentially relevant material. Kindly acknowledge implementation within 3 working days and advise the internal coordinator for further legal verification.

subject: Contract breach - installation delay
body: Under our agreement dated 3 June 2026, Nexora was to install 86 televisions and 24 refrigerators across our serviced apartments in Lonavala by 30 September. As of 22 October, 19 televisions remain uninstalled and 7 refrigerators have not been delivered. The delay has disrupted room readiness and incurred additional contractor costs. We are invoking Clause 11 concerning delay damages, presently calculated at INR 4,40,000 subject to final reconciliation. Please provide a recovery schedule and your contractual response within 10 days. We reserve our rights under the agreement.

subject: Notice
body: Please see attached notice. Reply urgently within the time stated therein.

subject: Last warning before cyber complaint
body: I paid INR 6,799 for a Nexora mobile accessory bundle through your website on 6 October, order NX-ON-928314. The parcel contained a different model and the support team has closed my refund request twice without explanation. One representative also sent my order details to a WhatsApp number that is not listed on your website. If I do not receive a written response and refund status by 5 PM on 28 October 2026, I will file a complaint with the cyber-crime portal and local police. I have saved the payment confirmation, chat transcript and delivery video.

subject: Fwd: Demand for arbitration costs
body: FYI, our client, Arclight Packaging Works, disputes the deduction of INR 5,28,000 from its final invoice for protective packaging supplied to Nexora's Mumbai warehouse. The purchase order refers to arbitration in Mumbai, and our client has requested that the parties first attempt settlement. Please confirm whether Nexora has already issued a debit note and whether the alleged damage reports are available. If the matter cannot be resolved through a meeting within 21 days, our client may proceed under the dispute resolution clause. Kindly avoid further adjustments until the ledger is reviewed.

subject: Samadhaan update - second reminder
body: Sir, our MSME claim is still pending and now the portal is showing that the buyer response is awaited. Total overdue amount is Rs 4,16,850 for aluminium brackets delivered in May and June. We have called accounts many times. Please tell us if Nexora disputes the quantity or quality, because nobody has shared any rejection note with us. The next hearing status is expected after 6 November.

subject: Electric shock incident - demand for records
body: I represent Mr. Jatin Babu, who alleges that a Nexora portable induction cooktop caused an electric shock at his residence in Secunderabad on 17 September 2026. He reports a minor hand injury and damage to the kitchen switchboard. The appliance was purchased through a local retailer, invoice no. VR-29118, and has been retained for inspection. Please provide the product batch traceability, quality inspection records, safety notices and service history relevant to the model within 14 days. Our client is also seeking reimbursement of medical and electrician expenses totalling INR 38,650. Please confirm arrangements for a joint inspection without prejudice to either party's position.

subject: RTI reply forwarded for comments
body: The attached RTI reply includes references to equipment purchased from Nexora under a state transport department procurement in 2025. The applicant has requested copies of warranty terms, comparative prices and maintenance response records. Please review the passages relating to Nexora and inform this office by 3 November 2026 if any factual corrections are required. The department will make its disclosure decision under the applicable law; this email is for factual verification only.

subject: Privacy complaint - recording without notice
body: During a service visit for my Nexora AC, the technician photographed the indoor unit and also captured family photographs visible on the wall. I was not told that the images would be uploaded anywhere. When I asked for deletion, the service supervisor said the pictures were already attached to a job record. Please explain the purpose, access controls and retention period for these images and confirm whether unrelated household details are accessible to field staff. I request a response within 10 days. My service reference is AC-DEL-617029.

subject: Fwd: takedown request from our counsel
body: Forwarding the demand sent by our counsel regarding a video published on a Nexora-associated social account on 8 October. The video shows a damaged refrigerator and says our repair workshop intentionally sells refurbished units as new. The workshop name and signboard are visible. We deny the allegation and believe the footage was taken from an unrelated repair. Please preserve the original upload and all internal approval messages while this is reviewed. Our counsel requests a correction or removal within 7 days.

subject: Unauthorised use of licensed firmware tool
body: We are writing on behalf of ByteForge Systems, the licensor of the diagnostic utility BF-Flash Pro. A copy of the utility appears to be distributed through a file-sharing location associated with a contractor who previously worked on Nexora appliance servicing. The licence granted to Nexora permitted use by 12 named technicians and did not permit redistribution. We request that you investigate, preserve relevant logs and disable any unauthorised public access if confirmed. Please respond within 14 days with the name of the responsible technical contact. We are open to resolving any genuine licensing misunderstanding.

subject: FYI - attendance required for GST inquiry
body: Nexora is requested to nominate an authorised representative for inquiry reference GST/INV/PN/2026/3327 concerning differences between e-way bill records and reported outward supplies for selected transactions during July–December 2025. Attendance is scheduled for 12 November 2026 at 10:00 AM. Please bring the transaction-level reconciliation, transport documents and relevant sales invoices listed in the annexure. Any request for rescheduling must be made in writing with supporting reasons.

subject: Assessment order - immediate review
body: The attached order relates to a tax assessment dispute involving disallowance of certain warranty provision expenses claimed by Nexora for AY 2023-24. The order records a demand of INR 27,84,200 inclusive of interest and refers to a response that the assessing officer considers incomplete. Please confirm the actual date of service through the tax portal because limitation for the available remedy may depend on that date. We recommend a meeting with the tax consultant within 3 days to decide the next step. Do not make payment or file an appeal based solely on this forwarded copy until authenticity is checked.

subject: Product marking verification - imported smart plugs
body: During a market surveillance exercise, smart plug units bearing Nexora branding were observed with a registration number that could not be matched to the model listed in the available records. Please provide the valid BIS registration certificate, importer declaration, model-wise technical specifications and copies of recent import documents within 10 days. This communication seeks clarification and should not be construed as a final finding. Details of the sampled unit and the inspection location in Ahmedabad are set out in the attached memo.

subject: Notice regarding workplace complaint
body: Our client has informed us that a complaint alleging inappropriate conduct at Nexora's Delhi facility was submitted to the designated internal committee on 6 October 2026. The complainant has not received an acknowledgement or information regarding the next procedural step. We request confirmation that the complaint has been received by the appropriate committee and that relevant access logs, meeting records and communications are being preserved. Please respond within 7 days without disclosing confidential personal information to unauthorised recipients. This letter is intended to ensure proper handling of the process and does not seek a predetermined outcome.

subject: Consumer complaint - discount claim
body: Our client purchased a Nexora 65-inch television after seeing an online advertisement stating 'flat 35% off'. At checkout, the discount was calculated against a reference price that the customer says was not the prevailing price in the preceding weeks. The order was placed on 2 October 2026 for INR 74,990. A complaint has been registered with the consumer authority under reference CCPA/2026/WZ/721. Please preserve the campaign creative, price logs, terms and approval trail and provide your response within 14 days. We seek clarification of the basis used to calculate the advertised saving.

subject: Fwd: insurer repudiation - transit damage
body: Forwarding the repudiation received from the carrier's insurer concerning a shipment of Nexora laptops damaged during transit from Pune to Hyderabad on 29 September 2026. The claim for INR 6,18,740 has been declined on the ground that the packaging was inadequate. The warehouse photographs appear to show crushed pallets before unloading, and the delivery receipt records external damage. Please confirm whether Nexora has its own cargo policy and whether the transporter's incident report is available. We need to decide within 21 days whether to seek review or initiate a formal dispute.

subject: Dealer agreement - territory overlap
body: Nexora appointed us for the Surat urban territory in January 2026. We have now learned that another dealer is being offered promotional support for the same postal zones, despite the exclusivity language in Schedule B. We have invested INR 11,20,000 in a showroom display and local advertising based on the original arrangement. Please provide the current territory map and explain whether the appointment terms have been amended. We request a meeting within 10 days before we take any further steps under the agreement.

sender_name: Maharashtra State Electricity Distribution Co. Ltd.
subject: Disconnection warning - commercial meter 77102984
body: The account associated with the Nexora service premises in Nashik shows an outstanding amount of INR 2,14,690, including charges arising from a disputed meter inspection. Unless the dues are paid or a written objection is lodged within 7 days, further action including disconnection may be initiated in accordance with applicable rules. If payment has already been made, please submit the transaction reference and receipt for reconciliation. The inspection report and calculation sheet are attached.

subject: Lok Adalat referral - case reference LA/TH/2026/1960
body: The attached intimation records referral of a pending payment dispute involving Nexora to the National Lok Adalat session scheduled for 28 November 2026. The parties may appear personally or through an authorised representative with settlement authority. Please review the amount claimed, confirm whether the matter remains unresolved and advise this office if the named company representative or address requires correction. This is a procedural intimation and does not indicate that a settlement has been reached.

subject: Need notarised affidavit and POA
body: We are preparing a response in a pending commercial proceeding and require a notarised affidavit from the authorised Nexora signatory, together with the board authorisation or power of attorney establishing signing authority. Please confirm the name and designation of the proposed signatory and whether the original authorisation is available. The court filing is due on 13 November 2026. Also advise whether the attached draft should be executed on stamp paper or in another prescribed form for the relevant jurisdiction. Kindly do not sign the draft until counsel has confirmed the final version.

subject: Fwd: termination for missed service levels
body: Our facilities team has recorded repeated failures to meet the response-time commitment under the service contract covering Nexora-supplied appliances at 11 UrbanStay properties. The agreement dated 1 April 2026 provides a four-hour response target for critical failures. For September, 17 tickets exceeded the agreed window, and we have incurred INR 3,72,000 in documented replacement and guest-relocation costs. We are issuing a notice to cure the breach within 14 days. If performance is not restored, we may terminate the affected locations and claim applicable liquidated damages. Please nominate a contract manager for a review meeting.

subject: Pls see
body: Please see attached notice and arrange reply before the deadline.

subject: police complaint if not sorted by Friday
body: I ordered a Nexora laptop for Rs 58,499 on 11 October, order NX-WEB-563812. The box delivered on 15 October had a different configuration and the serial number does not match the invoice. Your courier partner says the package was sealed at dispatch, and customer care has asked me to wait again. I have the unboxing recording and the delivery person's details. If I do not get a written resolution by 30 October 2026, I will file a police complaint and a cyber-crime report because the invoice and item supplied do not match. Please do not close ticket NX-CC-91802 without investigating the dispatch records.

subject: Arbitration clause - response overdue
body: Our client, Silverline Plastics, supplied moulded protective covers under Purchase Order NX-PO-60217. The invoice balance of INR 7,46,280 remains outstanding after deductions that our client disputes. Your procurement email of 30 September stated that the matter was 'under review', but no supporting defect report has been provided. We request that Nexora confirm its position within 30 days and propose a date for a pre-arbitration meeting. If the dispute remains unresolved, our client will rely on the dispute resolution clause in the purchase order and agreement.

subject: Outstanding bill and MSME application
body: We have not received payment for the precision brackets delivered to your Delhi warehouse on 18 July. Amount due is INR 3,68,920 against invoice PM-260718. Accounts says the vendor code is inactive, but we were never informed about this issue. We are a registered micro enterprise and have now filed for recovery through the appropriate MSME mechanism. Please reactivate the vendor record or explain the hold within 7 days. Kindly keep all further communication in writing.

subject: Claim for damage to premises following appliance failure
body: We represent the owner of a flat in Panvel where a Nexora front-load washing machine allegedly leaked during an unattended cycle on 25 September 2026. Water seepage damaged the laminate flooring and the ceiling of the unit below. The estimated repair expense is INR 1,86,500, excluding temporary accommodation costs. The appliance was inspected by a local technician, who noted a cracked inlet connector. Please arrange an independent inspection and preserve the relevant manufacturing and service records. Our client requests a response within 14 days and reserves the right to pursue compensation through the appropriate forum.

subject: Request for comments on RTI disclosure
body: An RTI applicant has sought details of vendor payments, delivery performance and warranty service obligations under a public procurement contract in which Nexora was a supplier. Before the department decides the disclosure request, please identify any specific commercial information that you believe may be exempt from disclosure and provide reasons with supporting documents by 9 November 2026. General objections without identifying the relevant records may not assist the decision-making process. The application and procurement schedule are enclosed.

subject: Personal information exposed in service ticket
body: Your technician's service report for my Nexora television contains my phone number and full home address. A screenshot of the same report was later sent to a public neighbourhood group by someone who said they were following up on the repair. I do not know whether this was a company employee or an outside service partner. Please investigate access to ticket NX-TV-705521, confirm whether the image was shared through an authorised channel and tell me how I can request deletion of the exposed details. I expect an acknowledgement within 3 days and a substantive response within 10 days.

subject: Defamatory statement in dealer circular
body: Our client, Kesar Electronics, disputes a statement in a circular circulated to retailers on 6 October 2026 suggesting that its outlet was removed from the network because it sold counterfeit Nexora products. No written finding or inspection report has been provided to our client. The statement has resulted in cancellation of two supply discussions. Please identify the author and approval authority for the circular, preserve its distribution list and issue a correction within 10 days if the allegation cannot be substantiated. Our client is willing to consider a mutually agreed clarification.

subject: Copyright infringement - service manual
body: TechLicence Publications owns the rights to the illustrated repair manual titled 'Domestic Cooling Systems: Field Edition 2024'. We have found a near-identical copy hosted in a publicly accessible support folder linked from a Nexora service partner page. The file includes our diagrams and proprietary troubleshooting tables. Please confirm whether Nexora or a contracted service provider uploaded the material, preserve upload logs and remove public access to the disputed file while ownership is reviewed. We request a written response within 7 days. A comparison report and the original publication record are attached.

sender_name: Office of the Deputy Commissioner of State Tax
subject: Notice for audit records - period 2024-25
body: Please refer to audit reference MHST/NSK/26/5704. Nexora is requested to produce sales registers, credit note details, stock transfer records and relevant tax invoices for the period 1 April 2024 to 31 March 2025. The review concerns differences between reported taxable turnover and data received from selected counterparties. A representative familiar with the accounts should attend on 16 November 2026. Kindly confirm attendance and provide an indexed set of documents in advance where feasible.

subject: Penalty order - payment mismatch
body: The attached order appears to impose a penalty of INR 8,76,000 following a review of reported deductions and tax payments for the relevant assessment period. The underlying notice refers to a mismatch between the tax deducted in vendor payments and the amount reflected in the quarterly statements. Please obtain the portal copy and filing acknowledgements before determining the next step. The response or appeal period stated in the order is 30 days from service. Kindly confirm the date on which the notice first became accessible to the authorised account holder.

subject: Clarification sought on export declaration
body: An export declaration associated with Nexora's shipment of electronic accessories to Sri Lanka has been selected for verification. The declared product description and the description appearing on the commercial invoice differ in material respects. Please provide the shipping bill, product catalogue, invoice, packing list and any applicable authorisation within 10 days. This request is for clarification of the record and does not constitute a final determination of non-compliance.

subject: Gratuity demand - former employee
body: We act for a former employee who separated from Nexora's Ahmedabad operation on 31 July 2026 after more than six years of service. The employee states that gratuity of INR 2,42,800 remains unpaid despite repeated follow-ups and submission of the required separation documents. A claim has been made before the competent gratuity authority. Please provide the calculation sheet, date of receipt of the application, any deficiency communication and proof of payment if made. Our client seeks a response within 14 days so the issue can be addressed before the next scheduled hearing.

subject: MRP and mandatory fee complaint
body: A customer has complained that a Nexora refrigerator listed with an MRP of INR 36,900 was sold for INR 37,650 after a mandatory 'handling charge' was added at checkout. The invoice was issued by an authorised retailer in Rajkot on 14 October 2026. The customer alleges that the additional charge was not disclosed before payment and has submitted a complaint to the consumer authority. Please provide the applicable pricing policy, retailer instructions and online listing history within 7 days. The claim may involve both the retailer's conduct and any company-issued pricing guidance.

subject: Insurance dispute - stock damage claim
body: We represent Nexora's distribution partner in a claim arising from a short circuit at its storage facility in Aurangabad on 8 September 2026. The insurer has offered INR 3,10,000 against a documented loss of INR 9,84,000, citing underinsurance and depreciation. The stock register indicates that a substantial portion of the affected goods belonged to Nexora and was held on consignment. Please confirm the ownership position, consignment terms and whether Nexora has already submitted any independent claim. We request the relevant documents within 21 days to assess the available recovery options.

subject: Security deposit refund after dealership closure
body: Our dealership in Jamnagar was discontinued effective 30 September. All display units listed in the closure sheet have been returned, but INR 4,50,000 of our deposit remains withheld. The regional sales office says there is a pending stock claim, but no itemised calculation has been shared. Please provide the closure statement and the clause under which the amount is being retained within 10 days. We are not refusing a legitimate adjustment; we need evidence and a chance to reconcile the figures.

subject: Notice for property tax reassessment
body: The commercial unit occupied by Nexora at Ring Road, Surat has been selected for property tax reassessment following a change in recorded floor area. The municipal register currently records 1,120 square metres, while the latest inspection notes 1,365 square metres including a storage mezzanine. Please submit the sanctioned layout, occupancy certificate and details of any approved alterations within 14 days. If the recorded area is incorrect, supporting evidence should be provided before the revised assessment is finalised.

subject: Case status changed - MISC/2026/004198
body: Automated intimation: the status of case MISC/2026/004198, in which Nexora is listed as a respondent, was updated on 22 October 2026. The registry entry indicates that a document has been uploaded by the filing party. This email is informational only and is not a substitute for the signed court order or formal service where required. Please verify the case number and review the attached system-generated status sheet.

subject: Please arrange verification and stamp duty review
body: We are finalising the documents for a proposed settlement with a service contractor and require confirmation of the authority of the Nexora signatory. Please provide the current board resolution or power of attorney and confirm whether the settlement instrument has been assessed for stamp duty in Maharashtra. The draft refers to a payment of INR 6,35,000 in full and final settlement, subject to execution and agreed release wording. Kindly send the verification documents by 6 November 2026. Please do not circulate the draft externally until the execution version is approved.

subject: Notice to terminate service arrangement
body: CrownCare Hospitals entered into a maintenance arrangement with Nexora on 15 January 2026 for refrigeration and air-conditioning equipment across five facilities. The agreed preventive maintenance visits for August and September were not completed at two locations, and emergency attendance exceeded the contractual response window on four occasions. We have incurred INR 2,85,000 in third-party repair charges. Unless a corrective plan is submitted within 7 days, we intend to terminate the affected portion of the agreement and claim the contractual service credits and other remedies available to us. Please nominate a representative for a discussion this week.

subject: Fwd: Notice attached - deadline 31 October
body: pls review the attachment and advise who will reply. It came by registered post today, and the deadline mentioned is 31 October 2026. I have not checked the annexures yet.

subject: Cyber complaint unless refund issued
body: I purchased a Nexora 2-ton AC for Rs 49,850 from your online store on 9 September, order NX-AC-104982. The product was delivered with a damaged outdoor unit and the replacement request has been pending for 18 days. Yesterday a caller claiming to be from your claims team asked me to share an OTP to process the refund. I did not share it, but I have the caller number and recording. Please investigate both the delivery issue and the suspected impersonation. If I do not receive a proper update by 2 November 2026, I will submit a cyber-crime complaint and a police report with the evidence.
